name: CohFrictPhys
description: An interaction physics<IPhys> that extends RotStiffFrictPhys adding a breakable cohesive nature. Used e.g. by Law2_ScGeom6D_CohFrictPhys_CohesionMoment.

attributes.name: cohesionDisablesFriction
attributes.description: is shear strength the sum of friction and adhesion or only adhesion?

attributes.name: cohesionBroken
attributes.description: is cohesion active? Set to false at the creation of a cohesive contact, and set to true when a fragile contact is broken

attributes.name: fragile
attributes.description: do cohesion disappear when contact strength is exceeded?

attributes.name: maxRollPl
attributes.description: Coefficient of rolling friction (negative means elastic).

attributes.name: maxTwistPl
attributes.description: Coefficient of twisting friction (negative means elastic).

attributes.name: normalAdhesion
attributes.description: tensile strength

attributes.name: shearAdhesion
attributes.description: cohesive part of the shear strength (a frictional term might be added depending on

attributes.name: unp
attributes.description: plastic normal displacement, only used for tensile behaviour and if

attributes.name: unpMax
attributes.description: maximum value of plastic normal displacement (counted positively), after that the interaction breaks even if

attributes.name: momentRotationLaw
attributes.description: set from momentRotationLaw in order to possibly use bending/twisting moment at contacts (if true). See always_use_moment_law for details.

attributes.name: initCohesion
attributes.description: Initialize the cohesive behaviour with current state as equilibrium state (same as

attributes.name: creep_viscosity
attributes.description: creep viscosity [Pa.s/m].

attributes.name: moment_twist
attributes.description: Twist moment

attributes.name: moment_bending
attributes.description: Bending moment

attributes.name: kr
attributes.description: rotational stiffness [N.m/rad]

attributes.name: ktw
attributes.description: twist stiffness [N.m/rad]

attributes.name: tangensOfFrictionAngle
attributes.description: tan of angle of friction

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear stiffness

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal stiffness

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
